name: Uyghur
notes: Uyghur, written in the Uyghur Perso-Arabic alphabet (Uyghur Ereb Yéziqi, UEY), the official script in Xinjiang. RESEARCH: grapheme inventory now specified. Unlike Persian/Arabic proper, UEY writes EVERY vowel with a full letter (ئا/ا ئە/ە ئو/و ئۇ/ۇ ئۆ/ۆ ئۈ/ۈ ئې/ې ئى/ى), so despite being classified `abjad` by script family it behaves as a near-alphabetic system (Hahn 1991, 'Spoken Uyghur'; Wikipedia 'Uyghur alphabets'): word-initial vowels carry a hamza-bearing letter (ئا, ئە, …) while the same vowel word-medially/finally drops the hamza (ا, ە, …) — the seat ⟨ئ⟩ is its own grapheme, silent word-initially and /ʔ/ everywhere else (positional_graphemes word_initial). Wikipedia 'Uyghur Arabic alphabet': ⟨ئ⟩ 'also represents /ʔ/ but it is usually ignored at the beginning of words. It still reads /ʔ/ in the middle, such as سائەت /sɑʔæt/ hour'. So ⟨ئ⟩ + vowel letter needs no key of its own: in either position its value is the seat's value followed by the vowel's, which fails all three key tests (AGENTS.md) — it is a concatenation, it is two segments wherever the seat is pronounced, and once the seat is a grapheme of its own there is no wrong longer match for such a key to block. WikiPron gold (uig_arab_broad) writes /ʔ/ for the seat word-initially too, in 572 of 580 seat-initial rows; that is a transcription convention the cited source contradicts, so the spec keeps the initial seat silent and the gold disagreement is accepted. ⟨ە⟩ is ARABIC LETTER AE (U+06D5), the bare form of ⟨ئە⟩ in every position after a consonant, medially and word-finally (قەشقەر Qeshqer, ئۇيغۇرچە Uyghurche); it writes /ɛ/ (Wikipedia 'Uyghur alphabets', vowel table: /æ~ɛ/, ULY e) and is distinct from ⟨ھ⟩ (U+06BE) /h/. It is not ARABIC LETTER HEH (U+0647) ⟨ه⟩, which looks the same in final position: UEY does not use that code point, which belongs to the pre-1950s Perso-Arabic spelling, where it is /h/ (Wikipedia 'Uyghur Arabic alphabet', historical spellings table, ULY h). A key on U+0647 matches no UEY text and leaves every bare ⟨ە⟩ unmapped. ⟨خ⟩ is realised as the uvular fricative /χ/ (not velar /x/) and ⟨غ⟩ as /ʁ/, matching Hahn's uvular analysis of the Uyghur dorsal fricative series (contrast the velar analysis used for `fa`/`glk`). ⟨ك⟩ and ⟨ک⟩ are both attested Kaf variants for /k/ in modern Uyghur typesetting and are mapped identically. ⟨ۋ⟩ covers both the labiodental approximant/fricative realisations reported in the literature (Hahn 1991). Latin (Uyghur Latin Yëziqi, ULY) and Cyrillic orthographies are also in use and are not modelled here. WikiPron gold (`uig_arab_broad.tsv`, ~2674 rows) is registered in scripts/benchmark.py's DATASETS; a PER is recorded in benchmarks/results.json. STRESS EXEMPTION: Uyghur word stress generally falls on the final syllable and is largely predictable rather than lexically contrastive; the position is not orthographically marked, so no `stress` block is declared here (exemption documented per docs/quality_tiers.md).
